title: STaR: Bootstrapping Reasoning With Reasoning
authors_zh: Eric Zelikman, Yuhuai Wu, Jesse Mu, Noah D. Goodman
paper_type_zh: 迭代式 rationale 自训练
best_for_zh: 适合用有标准答案但缺少书面 rationale 的题目构造推理 SFT 数据的研究者。
one_line: STaR repeatedly turns answer-correct model rationales into new SFT data, bootstrapping reasoning from few demonstrations.
STaR 反复把答案正确的模型 rationale 转成新一轮 SFT 数据，用少量示范自举推理能力。
why: It shows how answer keys can replace large-scale rationale annotation when terminal correctness is reliable.
inclusion_reason: STaR bootstraps rationale data by repeatedly training on self-generated chains that lead to correct answers.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Training a model to produce rationales normally needs many human-written chains, while few-shot prompting exposes only a small demonstration set and underuses questions that have answers but no explanations. This leaves rationale supervision expensive and difficult to scale.

STaR turns gold final answers into a bootstrap signal: a model generates rationales, keeps traces whose answers are correct, uses the known answer to rationalize failures, fine-tunes on accepted traces, and repeats. The direct product is an iterative rationale-training set with question, gold answer, generated trace, trace type, correctness, and training round.

L4 facts: primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.14465; NeurIPS 2022; boundary: post-training rationale construction with answer-level filtering, not pretraining or step verification; atlas value: a canonical self-generated demonstration loop; evaluation surface: synthetic arithmetic, CommonsenseQA, and GSM8K; collected from the official v2 paper.

训练模型生成理由通常需要大量人工推理链，而少样本提示只提供很小的示例集，无法充分利用“有答案但没有解释”的问题。这使理由监督既昂贵又难以扩展。

STaR 把最终标准答案变成自举信号：模型先生成理由，保留答案正确的轨迹；对失败题，在给定正确答案时重新生成理由；随后用入选轨迹微调并重复循环。直接产物是迭代式理由训练集，每条记录包含问题、标准答案、生成轨迹、轨迹类型、正确性和训练轮次。

L4 事实：主来源为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.14465；NeurIPS 2022；边界是带答案级筛选的后训练理由构造，而非预训练或步骤验证；对 atlas 的价值是提供经典的自生成 demonstration 循环；评测覆盖合成算术、CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K；本 Card 依据官方 v2 论文整理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
STaR repeatedly converts a model's answer-correct rationales into its next SFT set, and uses answer-conditioned rationalization to create training signal for questions the current model cannot solve unaided. The data object is a question, gold answer, generated rationale/final answer, normal-versus-rationalized trace type, acceptance result, and iteration; exact task matching is the feedback contract, so intermediate steps remain unverified. Compared with static self-training, the changed decision is to preserve successful reasoning traces, not just pseudo-label answers.

Google Scholar citations: 1818（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=STaR%3A+Bootstrapping+Reasoning+With+Reasoning&author=Eric+Zelikman&hl=en）

Open dataset: no new official downloadable STaR trace dataset was confirmed. Dataset name/URL: not applicable; experiments use synthetic arithmetic, CommonsenseQA, and GSM8K. Scale/record form: source-task sizes follow their releases; generated records contain question, rationale, final answer, correctness, trace type, and round. File format/license: not disclosed for generated traces. Intended use: iterative reasoning SFT/distillation; redistribution requires checking each source dataset's license.

STaR 反复把模型生成且答案正确的理由转成下一轮 SFT 数据，并通过“给定答案后再解释”给当前模型无法独立解出的题补充训练信号。数据对象包括问题、标准答案、生成理由与最终答案、普通或答案条件化轨迹类型、接纳结果和迭代轮次；反馈契约是任务答案匹配，因此中间步骤仍未验证。相对静态自训练，它改变的是保留成功推理轨迹，而不只是生成伪答案标签。

Google Scholar 引用数：1818（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=STaR%3A+Bootstrapping+Reasoning+With+Reasoning&author=Eric+Zelikman&hl=en）

开源数据：未确认发布新的官方 STaR 轨迹数据集。数据集名称与地址：不适用；实验使用合成算术、CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K。规模与记录形式：源任务规模沿用各自发布；生成记录包含问题、理由、最终答案、正确性、轨迹类型和轮次。文件格式与许可：论文未披露生成轨迹的格式与许可。用途：迭代式推理 SFT 或蒸馏；再分发前需核对各源数据许可。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Initialize. Input: a pretrained model, questions with gold answers, and a small few-shot rationale prompt. Operation: fix task splits and prompts. Output/transition: the current model and unsolved training questions. Check/stop: every question must have a reliable terminal answer key.
  1. Generate and filter. Input: each question and the current model. Operation: sample a rationale plus final answer and compare the answer with gold. Output/transition: correct normal traces enter the candidate SFT set; failures go to rationalization. Check/stop: answer equality/task matching accepts a trace; no step verifier is used.
  1. Rationalize failures. Input: a failed question and its gold answer as a hint. Operation: generate a rationale leading to that answer, then remove the hint from the stored training input. Output/transition: answer-conditioned traces join successful normal traces. Check/stop: the regenerated answer must match gold; trace type remains recorded.
  1. Fine-tune and repeat. Input: accepted traces from the round. Operation: fine-tune the base model, regenerate the corpus, and start another iteration. Output: a new model and rationale set. Check/stop: stop when performance plateaus. Reproduction requires the exact checkpoint, few-shot examples, temperature, iterations, splits, answer parser, and trace mixing policy.

1. 初始化。 输入：预训练模型、带标准答案的问题，以及少量理由示例 prompt。操作：固定任务划分和提示。输出与流转：当前模型和待解训练问题。检查与停止：每道题都必须有可靠终局答案。
  1. 生成并筛选。 输入：每个问题和当前模型。操作：采样理由与最终答案，再与标准答案比较。输出与流转：正确的普通轨迹进入候选 SFT 集，失败样本进入答案条件化解释。检查与停止：答案匹配决定接纳；没有步骤 verifier。
  1. 解释失败题。 输入：失败问题，以及作为提示的标准答案。操作：生成能导向该答案的理由，保存训练记录时不把提示答案放入输入。输出与流转：答案条件化轨迹与普通成功轨迹合并。检查与停止：重新生成的答案必须匹配标准答案，并保留轨迹类型。
  1. 微调并重复。 输入：本轮入选轨迹。操作：微调基座模型，用更新后的模型重新生成语料，再开始下一轮。输出：新模型与新理由集。检查与停止：表现不再提高时停止。复现必须固定 checkpoint、少样本示例、temperature、轮数、split、答案解析器和轨迹混合规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: CommonsenseQA comparison (Table 1). Claim: selected self-generated rationales improve a 6B model beyond answer-only fine-tuning, and rationalization adds coverage. Controlled setup: GPT-J is the shared 6B base; direct fine-tuning uses answer-only data, STaR trains on accepted traces, and the rationalization variant conditions failures on gold answers. Dev accuracy is 60.0 for direct fine-tuning, 68.8 for STaR without rationalization, and 72.5 with rationalization while using 86.7% of training questions; the paper compares 72.5 with 73.0 from a roughly 30× larger GPT-3 model. This supports answer-checkable bootstrapping, not step faithfulness or tasks without gold answers.

CommonsenseQA 比较（表 1）。 主张：筛选自生成理由能让 6B 模型超过只训练答案的 baseline，答案条件化解释还能补充覆盖。受控设置：各组共享 GPT-J 6B 基座；直接微调用答案数据，STaR 用入选轨迹训练，解释版本还会给失败生成提供标准答案。开发集准确率分别为：直接微调 60.0、无解释 STaR 68.8、带解释 STaR 72.5，后者使用了 86.7% 的训练问题；论文还将 72.5 与约大 30 倍的 GPT-3 模型 73.0 比较。该结果支持答案可核验任务上的自举，但不证明步骤忠实，也不覆盖没有标准答案的任务。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Human-written rationales and pseudo-label self-training are the closest baselines. STaR changes the supervised object from an answer label to an accepted rationale trace: generate a rationale, check its terminal answer, and train again on the successful traces. Its answer-conditioned retry also recovers training examples from questions the current model initially misses. It does not introduce step-level verification or prove that the retained rationale is faithful.
最接近的基线是人工编写 rationale 和基于伪标签的自训练。STaR 把监督对象从答案标签改为通过筛选的 rationale 轨迹：先生成 rationale，再检查终局答案，最后用成功轨迹继续训练。它还通过给失败题提供正确答案来补写 rationale，从当前模型做错的题中恢复训练样本。它没有引入逐步验证，也不能证明保留的 rationale 忠实反映模型的推理过程。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Post-hoc rationalization. A retry conditioned on the gold answer may produce a plausible explanation that the model would not find unaided; audit normal and rationalized traces separately.
  • Terminal-only supervision. A correct final answer can hide invalid intermediate steps, so tasks needing process correctness require a step verifier or manual audit.
  • Selection feedback. Keeping only successful traces can amplify early model and answer-parser biases; track per-round acceptance rates, source splits, and failure clusters.

• 事后合理化。 在给定正确答案的条件下重试，可能产生模型独立作答时找不到的合理解释；审计时应分开统计普通轨迹和补写轨迹。
  • 仅监督终局。 最终答案正确仍可能掩盖错误的中间步骤，因此要求过程正确的任务还需逐步验证器或人工审计。
  • 选择反馈。 只保留成功轨迹会放大早期模型和答案解析器的偏差；应逐轮记录通过率、来源划分和集中失败类型。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use STaR to build reasoning SFT data for a task with many questions and reliable gold answers but few written rationales. Feed in questions, answer keys, a base model, and a small rationale prompt; generate traces, filter them by answer correctness, rationalize failures, and output a round-tagged rationale dataset plus a fine-tuned model. Success means held-out task accuracy rises without collapsing trace diversity or acceptance coverage. Do not use terminal-answer filtering alone when answers are open-ended, the checker is noisy, or process faithfulness is required.

当一个任务有大量问题和可靠的标准答案、但缺少人工 rationale 时，可以用 STaR 构造推理 SFT 数据。输入问题、答案键、基础模型和少量 rationale 提示，生成并按答案正确性筛选轨迹，再为失败题补写 rationale；输出是带训练轮次标记的 rationale 数据集和微调模型。成功标准是留出集准确率提升，同时轨迹多样性和题目覆盖率没有明显退化。若答案开放、检查器噪声大或任务要求过程忠实性，就不应只使用终局答案筛选。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: STaR is a data-generation loop, not merely a prompting method; accepted model-written rationales become the next SFT set.
  2. Use when: questions have reliable answer keys and rationale annotation is the bottleneck.
  3. Record: question, gold answer, rationale, predicted answer, normal/rationalized type, acceptance decision, and round.
  4. Do not infer: answer correctness does not establish step correctness or faithful reasoning.
  5. Audit first: compare normal and answer-conditioned traces, per-round coverage, and held-out gains before scaling.

1. 应记住： STaR 是数据生成循环，而不只是提示方法；通过筛选的模型 rationale 会成为下一轮 SFT 数据。
  2. 适用条件： 问题有可靠答案键，而且 rationale 标注成本是主要瓶颈。
  3. 必须记录： 问题、标准答案、rationale、预测答案、普通或补写类型、接纳决定和训练轮次。
  4. 不能推出： 答案正确不代表中间步骤正确，也不代表推理过程忠实。
  5. 扩展前审计： 分别比较普通轨迹和给定答案的补写轨迹，检查逐轮覆盖率与留出集收益。
